queue_scope_dependency: CW-SCOPE-QUEUE-V1-2026-09-06 assigns blob delivery to a separate profile
warning: All object keys, capability seeds, salts, and padding are fixed test data only and MUST NOT be used in production.

negative.name: ciphertext_bit_flip
negative.operation: For each ciphertext chunk, xor byte 0 with 0x01; require digest mismatch and no plaintext release.

negative.name: chunk_reordering
negative.operation: Decrypt chunk 1 at index 0 or chunk 0 at index 1; require AEAD failure because the index is authenticated.

negative.name: manifest_truncation
negative.operation: Remove the final 32-byte digest; require MALFORMED_FRAME before upload state is created.

negative.name: identity_mismatch
negative.operation: Replace blob_id_hex with 32 zero bytes at COMMIT; require IDENTITY_MISMATCH and keep the upload uncommitted.

negative.name: partial_upload_visibility
negative.operation: Store only chunk 0, require INCOMPLETE from COMMIT and NOT_FOUND from GET_MANIFEST and GET_CHUNK.

negative.name: capability_cross_role
negative.operation: Sign GET_CHUNK with the upload, renew, or delete seed; require UNAUTHORIZED and return no content.

negative.name: expired_capability
negative.operation: At now equal to expires-at, try each operation; require EXPIRED or NOT_FOUND, no content, no renewal, and no mutation.

negative.name: committed_mutation
negative.operation: After COMMIT, retry PUT_CHUNK with different bytes or BEGIN_UPLOAD with changed metadata; require conflict and leave committed bytes unchanged.
